title: CPSC, ECR International Announce Recall to Repair of Gas Boilers
summary: The burners on these boilers could produce excess carbon monoxide (CO) in the flue, due to improper combustion, posing a risk of CO poisoning to consumers. Units: About 8,000.

title: CPSC, Prestige Toy Corp. Announce Recall of Duckie Ring Rattle/Teethers
summary: The rattle may break, causing small beads to fall out, which presents a potential choking hazard to young children. Units: About 4,600.

title: CPSC, QVC, Inc., Announce Recall of Red Devil Gas Grills
summary: The product's design allows consumers to light the grill at an air intake tube, instead of at the burner. When the grill is lit at the air intake tube, it will appear to function normally, though gas inside the air intake tube will ignite. The tube can reach temperatures of up to 750 degrees Fahrenh

title: CPSC, E-filliate Inc. Announce Recall of Extension Cords
summary: The cords have reversed polarity, which can present electric shock and electrocution hazards to consumers. Units: About 30,000.

title: CPSC, Fitness Quest Inc. Announce Recall of "Total Gym" Exercise Machines
summary: The handles on these exercise machines can detach during use and the cable attached to the handles can break, resulting in injury to the user. Units: About 310,000.

title: CPSC, Philips Electronics Announce Recall of Speaker Power Adapters Sold with HP Computers
summary: The speaker power adapter's power cord connector is not grounded, posing a potential shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 93,000.

title: CPSC, Seismic Safety Products Inc. Announce Recall of Gas Shut-Off Valves
summary: These gas valves could stick in the open position, allowing gas to flow freely, which poses a risk of serious injury to consumers, from fire and explosion during an earthquake. Units: Approximately 600.

title: CPSC, Milwaukee Tool Corp. Announce Recall of Automotive Chargers
summary: The automotive chargers are often used on job sites to charge power tool batteries. When used under low voltage conditions, the chargers can overheat. This poses a fire hazard. Units: About 18,000.

title: CPSC, Rocky Mountain Bicycles Announce Recall of Mountain Bicycles
summary: The chainstay that holds the rear wheel in place can fail, causing the rear wheel to separate from the bicycle. This can cause the rider to lose control and crash. Units: About 660.

title: CPSC, Ryobi Technologies, Inc. Announce Recall of Hammer Drills
summary: The on-off trigger can stick, or the lock-on button can jam, posing a risk of physical injury to consumers. Units: About 6,000.

title: CPSC, Astra International and Consumers Union Announce Recall of Glove Compartment Organizer
summary: The flashlight can overheat when the batteries are inserted, presenting a possible burn hazard. Also, the tire gauge does not produce accurate measurements when used. Units: About 15,000.

title: CPSC, Baseline Design Announce Recall of Bean Bag Chairs
summary: The bean bags contain small polystyrene beads that present suffocation and strangulation hazards to young children who may inhale the small beads. The recalled bean bag chairs have zippers that were not properly sealed to prevent young children from opening the bean bag chairs and being exposed to t

title: CPSC and Sears Announce Recall of Riding Lawn Mower
summary: Under certain operating conditions, the vehicle's transmission may fail, causing a loss of drive and brake ability. Should this occur, the potential for personal injury and/or property damage exists. Units: About 900.

title: CPSC, Club Car, Inc. Announce Recall of Golf Cars
summary: The fuel tank may leak, posing a potential fire hazard. Units: About 7,300.

title: CPSC, Eugenio Serafin Inc. Announce Recall of Electric Showerhead Hot Water Heaters Sold in Puerto Rico
summary: The nozzle can be easily unscrewed, exposing the uninsulated heater coil. The heater coil's grounding screw does not sufficiently reduce the current through the water, posing an electrocution and shock hazard to the bather. Units: About 32,500.

title: CPSC, Total Gym Fitness LLC Announce Recall of Exercise Equipment Sold by TV Infomercials
summary: A lever pin that supports the elevated railing of the glideboard could fail, causing the user to fall. Units: About 3,100.

title: CPSC, Best Lock Corp. Announce Recall of Electronic Door Locks
summary: In an extreme fire situation, it is possible for the electronic wires and mounting holes to become exposed, posing a fire hazard risk. There is no danger of latch failure, nor will this prevent normal egress during an emergency evacuation. Units: About 8,000.

title: CPSC, D.A.M. Clothing, Inc., Announce Recall of Basic Editions 2-Piece Toddler Girls' Short Set
summary: The buttons on the garment are sewn on too loosely, creating a danger of them falling off or being easily pulled off, which poses a potential choking hazard to young children. Units: About 9,200.

title: CPSC, Lands' End, Inc. Announce Recall of Soft Farm Set
summary: The legs of the chicken and duck figures may detach, posing a risk of choking. Units: About 600.

title: CPSC, Southern Wood Products Announce Recall of Children's Toy Box
summary: The middle lid support hinge can collapse suddenly and cause an injury to a child's head, neck, fingers, or hands; or can become an entrapment hazard to young children. Units: About 600.

title: CPSC, The Sportsman's Guide Announce Recall of the Big Red Wagon
summary: The Big Red Wagon has four rubber wheels that include plastic rims that may break and explode under pressure, when being inflated. Parts of the wheel and the tire can strike and injure anyone nearby. Units: About 1,000.

title: CPSC Issues Warning About Hazardous Red Devil Gas Grills
summary: The product's design allows consumers to light the grill at an air intake tube, instead of at the burner. title: CPSC, Spin Master Toys Announce Recall of Firestormer and Skyblazer Toy Planes
summary: The plastic air intake chamber of the air-powered toy planes can burst, throwing plastic pieces, posing a laceration, bruise and abrasion hazard to consumers. Units: About 137,000.

title: CPSC, Aqua-Leisure Industries Inc. Remind Consumers about Recall of Inflatable Baby Floats
summary: The leg holes in the seat of the float can tear, causing children to unexpectedly fall into the water and, possibly, drown. Units: About 98,000.

title: CPSC, Kolcraft Announce Recall of Toy Steering Wheels Sold on Strollers
summary: The steering wheel can break away from its base, allowing the small plastic turn signal and horn pieces to come off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 17,000.

title: CPSC, Rose Art Industries Announce Recall to Repair Cotton Candy Machine
summary: The motors on the cotton candy machines can jam and overheat, posing a fire hazard. Additionally, the heating unit can be activated without the spinner in place, presenting a risk of burn to consumers. Units: About 188,000.

title: CPSC, NHTSA, and Dorel Juvenile Group Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Infant Car Seats/Carriers
summary: When the seat is used as a carrier, the plastic handle can unexpectedly release from the carrying position. When this happens, an unrestrained infant can fall to the ground and suffer injuries. Units: About 26,000.
